research_rationale:
EO 11213 (1965-04-02, 30 FR 4389) is an order under section 6103(a) of the Internal Revenue Code of 1954, as amended by section 3(c) of the Interest Equalization Tax Act, opening certain interest equalization tax returns to inspection. I read the full held Federal Register text (jobs/fr-originals/data/full_run/texts/EO_11213.txt, 30 FR 4389, PDF pages 9-9) and confirmed its number, title and signature date against the census register. EO 12553 (signed 1986-02-25) revokes it by number; the dossier already carries the agent-located, independently upheld ACT record for that revocation, which I checked against the held EO 12553 text (operative sentence and table row "11213 Providing for inspection of certain interest equalization tax information returns by the Board of"). The first end is that express revocation.
